graph.name: Etion Continuous Integration and Automated VPC Deployment Architecture
graph.notes: This architecture illustrates Etion's automated pipeline that streamlines code deployment and infrastructure provisioning using AWS CodePipeline, CodeCommit, CodeBuild, Amazon ECR, and AWS CloudFormation to consistently instantiate VPC environments with ECS, IAM roles, and Application Load Balancers.

nodes.name: Dev
nodes.notes: Developer committing application and infrastructure code changes into the repository.

nodes.name: CODEPIPELINE
nodes.notes: AWS CodePipeline orchestrating the end-to-end continuous integration and deployment stages.

nodes.name: CODECOMMIT
nodes.notes: AWS CodeCommit repository storing source code and CloudFormation templates.

nodes.name: CODEBUILD
nodes.notes: AWS CodeBuild executing build steps, spinning up temporary build containers, and creating application container images.

nodes.name: CLOUDFORMATION
nodes.notes: AWS CloudFormation managing resource provisioning through a 3-step change set, approval, and execution process.

nodes.name: REGISTRY
nodes.notes: Amazon ECR storing container images ready for deployment.

nodes.name: VPC
nodes.notes: Target Virtual Private Cloud environment isolated for customer deployments.

nodes.name: ECS
nodes.notes: Amazon ECS running application tasks within the target VPC.

nodes.name: IAM
nodes.notes: IAM roles and permissions configured for application security within the VPC.

nodes.name: ALB
nodes.notes: Application Load Balancer deployed alongside the application tasks inside the VPC.

edges.notes: Developer commits code updates into the CodeCommit repository.
CodeCommit triggers the CodeBuild stage to start container compilation.
CodeBuild pushes the compiled container image to Amazon ECR Registry.
CloudFormation provisions and deploys application infrastructure components (ECS task definitions, IAM roles, and ALB) into the VPC.
